business_problem: Coastal Community Bank needed to onboard partners faster and share regulated banking data securely because older inputs and mainframe-era processes slowed partner integrations, risk analysis, and compliance work.
solution_summary: Coastal Community Bank uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Sharing, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog to support banking-as-a-service data sharing and compliance analytics. Coastal Community Bank needed to onboard partners faster and share regulated banking data securely because older inputs and mainframe-era processes slowed partner integrations, risk analysis, and compliance work. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Delta Sharing. Legacy operational and analytics data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Delta Sharing.
